The correct volume is 6³ = 216 cubic inches.

The proposed solution set the space diagonal equal to the diameter, which would describe a cube inscribed in the sphere, not a sphere inscribed in the cube. Its answer of 24√3 ≈ 41.6 is also smaller than the sphere's own volume (36π ≈ 113), so it can't be right.
